papers.title: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Patch-wise Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have become a leading approach to real-time interactive video generation and video world modeling. However, existing methods typically allocate computation uniformly across space when generating the next video chunk, updating all patches with the same denoising schedule and number of function evaluations. This ignores the spatial heterogeneity of video content: static, simple, or recurring regions are often easier to denoise, while other regions require further refinement or additional context. A uniform budget thus leads to redundant computation on easy patches, whereas reducing the fixed step count can leave difficult patches insufficiently refined. We introduce \methodname{}, a general framework that dynamically allocates denoising steps to individual patches: easy patches stop early to improve efficiency, while difficult patches receive more refinement steps. This design accelerates generation with negligible quality degradation. Our method is compatible with most existing few-step autoregressive diffusion models, requiring only a lightweight routing module with modest training. Experiments demonstrate that \methodname{} reduces the total number of denoising steps applied across video patches by about 50\% while maintaining visual quality comparable to the four-step baseline.
papers.summary_cn: 论文提出ForcingBooster，用轻量级路由器根据每个潜在图像块的内容、历史上下文和条件信号，动态决定其是否继续去噪。已收敛的简单区域使用中间干净潜变量提前退出，并将其键值表示缓存供其他区域使用；复杂或条件敏感区域继续细化。作者通过停止损失和计算成本损失进行在线策略训练，以冻结的完整去噪结果作为监督，无需额外视频数据或人工停止标签。在Causal Forcing、Wan2.1、LingBot-World-V2和LongLive等模型上的实验显示，该方法通常实现约1.15至1.31倍端到端加速，并在接近四步基线质量的同时减少约50%的图像块去噪步数；低运动视频中的步数削减最高约75%。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出面向自回归视频扩散的自适应图像块级去噪框架，使不同空间区域拥有不同的去噪预算。2. 利用每一步的中间干净潜变量实现图像块提前退出，并通过KV缓存保留已停止区域的上下文。3. 设计结合重建误差与预期去噪成本的路由器训练目标，并采用当前路由策略生成的在线轨迹估计继续计算成本。4. 证明仅训练轻量级路由器、冻结原始生成器即可在多个视频生成和世界模型上减少计算，同时维持接近四步采样的视觉质量。
papers.relevance_cn: 该工作直接针对实时视频生成和视频世界模型中的推理延迟问题。它属于自回归、因果、流式视频生成范式，在保持分块生成和历史KV缓存的基础上，进一步进行空间图像块级的自适应去噪。其核心优化是动态分配去噪步数，而非对所有区域统一执行固定步数，与研究重点中的实时生成、扩散蒸馏后的少步采样、稀疏计算和缓存复用高度相关。对于动作或相机条件驱动的世界模型，方法可根据新出现区域、运动物体和条件敏感区域增加计算，从而在闭环交互场景中兼顾速度与局部细节。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文未设置单独的局限性讨论，但实验和方法描述表明：1. 首个视频块仍采用完整的四步去噪，因此加速主要作用于后续视频块；2. 端到端加速低于图像块去噪步数削减比例，说明路由、KV缓存构建、文本编码和VAE解码等开销仍然存在；3. 路由器需要针对停止阈值和计算成本权重进行训练与调节，阈值变化会影响运行时间和结果；4. 训练监督依赖冻结生成器的完整步数输出，因此主要优化的是相对基线的一致性，而非直接保证真实视频或任务目标的最优性；5. 加速效果依赖视频动态程度，低运动视频收益更大，高运动视频的收益相对有限；6. 论文未明确说明在更长时间跨度、极端快速运动或复杂闭环交互中的稳定性。
papers.abstract_cn: 自回归视频扩散模型已成为实时交互式视频生成和视频世界建模的主流方法。然而，现有方法通常在生成下一个视频块时对空间位置均匀分配计算量，对所有图像块采用相同的去噪调度和函数评估次数。这忽略了视频内容在空间上的异质性：静态、简单或重复出现的区域通常更容易去噪，而其他区域则需要进一步细化或更多上下文。统一的计算预算会导致对简单图像块进行冗余计算；但减少固定步数又可能使困难图像块无法得到充分细化。我们提出ForcingBooster，这是一种通用框架，可动态地为单个图像块分配去噪步数：简单图像块提前停止以提升效率，而困难图像块则获得更多细化步骤。该设计能够在几乎不降低质量的情况下加速生成。我们的方法兼容大多数现有的少步数自回归扩散模型，只需进行适度训练即可引入轻量级路由模块。实验表明，ForcingBooster将视频图像块上执行的去噪总步数减少约50%，同时保持与四步基线相当的视觉质量。

papers.title: Connected Self Forcing: Beyond Local Learning in Video Autoregression
papers.abstract: To stream long videos while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency, Self Forcing mitigates exposure bias through self-rollout training on self-generated histories with key-value (KV) caching. To keep memory manageable, it detaches historical caches, preserving forward dependencies between chunks but severing the backward gradient paths. We introduce Connected Self Forcing, a training framework that reconnects gradient paths across autoregressive chunks, allowing feedback from later predictions to guide how earlier context is generated. These connections go beyond historical KV-writing: gradients pass through generated latents into the computations that produced them, linking the generation of earlier context to its use in later predictions. To make this connected training memory-efficient, we develop shortcut gradient replay, which recovers cross-chunk gradients without retaining the full rollout computation graph. Integrated with distribution matching distillation, Connected Self Forcing trains historical chunks according to both their direct supervision and their contribution to subsequent generation. Experiments on autoregressive video generation show improvements in long-horizon visual quality and temporal consistency, without changing the inference procedure.
papers.summary_cn: 论文指出，Self Forcing 虽然通过自生成历史缓解了训练与推理不一致问题，但为节省内存而分离历史 KV 缓存，导致后续分块的损失无法反向指导早期分块及其上下文生成。Connected Self Forcing 通过快捷梯度重放，将后续分块的梯度经历史 KV 状态传回早期分块的 KV 写入和生成过程，同时避免保留完整自回归计算图。实验基于 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 和 DMD，在约 60 秒及 240 秒视频上显示，该方法相较 Self Forcing 和 Self Gradient Forcing 通常具有更好的美学质量、背景一致性、成像质量和主体一致性，并减少长期生成中的主体与场景漂移；但动态程度的表现依赖初始化方式和反馈权重。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 识别了 Self Forcing 中的前向—反向间隙：历史分块会在前向生成中影响后续预测，但由于缓存分离，后续损失无法反向影响早期上下文生成。 2. 提出 Connected Self Forcing，通过 Shortcut Gradient Replay 经历史 KV 状态恢复选定的跨分块梯度路径，并将其传回历史分块的上下文写入和生成过程。 3. 在不保留完整 rollout 图、不增加模型参数且不改变推理流程的前提下，以重新计算换取较低的激活内存。 4. 在 60 秒和 240 秒自回归视频生成评测中验证了长时视觉质量和时间一致性的改进。
papers.relevance_cn: 该工作直接面向研究重点中的自回归、因果、流式和长视频生成：它训练模型使用自身生成的历史，并通过 KV 缓存维持跨分块上下文，适合长时序和流式生成。其核心贡献是利用后续预测的反馈优化早期历史，能够减少长 rollout 中的主体、背景和场景漂移，因此与闭环式视觉世界模型中的长期状态保持具有直接关系。方法与视频扩散蒸馏结合，并通过快捷梯度重放降低训练内存需求；但它不改变推理流程，也未提出新的稀疏注意力、缓存压缩或推理加速机制，因此与实时生成的关系主要体现在训练可扩展性和长时稳定性，而非推理速度提升。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文的实验主要基于 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B、DMD 后训练、四步去噪和文本到视频分块生成，验证范围有限，未证明其对其他架构、任务或视频条件控制任务同样有效。方法通过快捷路径恢复选定的跨分块梯度，并在目标历史分块处终止反馈，并非完整的跨整个 rollout 的反向传播，因此可能遗漏部分梯度依赖。论文显示效果依赖初始化方式和跨分块反馈权重：某些设置下动态程度低于基线，减小反馈权重也会牺牲若干质量和一致性指标。快捷梯度重放以额外计算和重放开销换取激活内存节省，论文提供了相关效率分析但未在正文中给出完整的成本权衡。评测使用有限的提示集合和固定基准，且训练阶段未加载额外真实视频；对真实交互式世界建模、动作条件控制和实际实时系统的效果，论文未明确说明。
papers.abstract_cn: 为了在保持视觉质量和时间一致性的同时流式生成长视频，Self Forcing 通过在模型自行生成的历史上进行自回归 rollout，并结合键值（KV）缓存来缓解暴露偏差。为控制内存开销，它将历史缓存从计算图中分离，在保留分块之间前向依赖的同时切断反向梯度路径。我们提出 Connected Self Forcing，这是一种重新连接自回归分块间梯度路径的训练框架，使后续预测产生的反馈能够指导早期上下文的生成。这些连接不仅限于历史 KV 的写入：梯度还会穿过生成的潜变量，进入产生这些潜变量的计算过程，从而将早期上下文的生成与其在后续预测中的使用联系起来。为实现内存高效的连接式训练，我们提出快捷梯度重放，在无需保留完整 rollout 计算图的情况下恢复跨分块梯度。Connected Self Forcing 与分布匹配蒸馏相结合，使历史分块同时依据其直接监督信号及其对后续生成的贡献进行训练。在自回归视频生成实验中，该方法提升了长时间跨度下的视觉质量和时间一致性，同时不改变推理过程。

papers.title: LiteNWM: Efficient Latent World Models for Onboard Visual Navigation in the Wild
papers.abstract: Direct visual navigation policies generate trajectories efficiently but do not explicitly evaluate their future consequences. Generative navigation world models provide this foresight through visual rollouts, which are costly when evaluating multiple candidates. We present LiteNWM, a latent navigation world model that shares visual encoding across candidates and jointly predicts their action-conditioned future representations at multiple horizons, while a learned scorer uses these predictions to select trajectories. In offline evaluations on RECON, SCAND, and SACSoN, LiteNWM reduces macro-averaged trajectory error by 17.56% relative to NoMaD+NWM-XL and achieves a 128.00-fold end-to-end speedup on an RTX 5090. The same evaluator transfers from NoMaD to MBRA without proposer-specific retraining, reducing MBRA's macro-averaged trajectory error by 16.2%. In real-robot experiments in unseen indoor and outdoor environments, LiteNWM improves navigation success from 43.3% to 83.3% relative to NoMaD. These results demonstrate that LiteNWM can be deployed for future-aware planning and closed-loop navigation on a physical robot.
papers.summary_cn: 本文提出 LiteNWM，用于在视觉导航中高效评估候选轨迹。系统冻结导航策略，利用共享的 DINOv3 视觉编码、动作条件的潜在空间预测器以及相对于当前最优轨迹的评分器，联合预测 H1–H4 多个时间范围的未来特征，并据此筛选候选轨迹，从而避免为每条候选轨迹生成 RGB 视频。RECON、SCAND 和 SACSoN 实验显示，LiteNWM 在轨迹误差和成功率方面优于 NoMaD 及基于 RGB rollout 的 NWM，同时显著降低推理时间和资源消耗。评估器还可迁移到 MBRA，并在 Unitree Go2 EDU 上未见环境中实现闭环导航。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 识别出逐候选轨迹的 RGB rollout 是导航世界模型的主要计算瓶颈，并通过共享视觉编码和批量联合预测重构评估流程。2. 提出结合位姿条件动作预测、多时间范围潜在表示预测和相对当前轨迹评分的候选轨迹评估方法。3. 通过消融实验验证多时间范围未来特征及正确的候选—未来配对对轨迹选择的作用。4. 在三个导航数据集上验证精度和效率提升，实现相对 NoMaD+NWM-XL 的大幅端到端加速，并展示无需提议器专门训练即可迁移到 MBRA。5. 在 Unitree Go2 EDU 上验证了未见室内外环境中的真实机器人闭环导航。
papers.relevance_cn: 该工作与研究重点高度相关。它是一个动作条件视觉世界模型：根据候选动作序列预测未来视觉潜在表示，并用预测后果进行轨迹选择。其共享编码、批量候选预测和不带自回归反馈的 H1–H4 联合预测直接对应实时生成、稀疏计算和缓存/特征复用方向。模型不生成 RGB 帧，而是在潜在空间进行未来预测，因此显著降低了多候选评估成本；同时通过滚动时域反复观测、预测、执行和重规划，实现了面向物理机器人的闭环导航与视觉模拟。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文的评估主要采用四步短时域候选轨迹；作者指出，NWM 原本面向八步 rollout，改 adapt 到四步可能影响其表现，因此结果不能直接与原始 NWM 的八步结果比较。LiteNWM 依赖冻结的导航提议策略、冻结的 DINOv3 编码器和预先训练的评估器，尚未验证联合微调或更广泛提议策略下的效果。离线实验使用三个数据集的固定开发子集，每个域包含 100 个查询状态；真实机器人实验覆盖三个场景、每种方法共 30 次试验，规模有限。效率结果主要在 RTX 5090 上测量，不能直接代表其他硬件或机载平台的性能。方法当前聚焦于导航，论文将其扩展到操作任务列为未来工作。论文还报告了不同部分之间存在速度提升数值差异，具体取决于测量边界和实验设置。
papers.abstract_cn: 直接视觉导航策略能够高效生成轨迹，但不会显式评估这些轨迹的未来后果。生成式导航世界模型通过视觉 rollout 提供这种前瞻能力，但在评估多个候选轨迹时计算成本很高。我们提出 LiteNWM，一种潜在空间导航世界模型。它在不同候选轨迹之间共享视觉编码，并在多个时间范围联合预测其动作条件的未来表示，同时利用学习得到的评分器根据这些预测选择轨迹。在 RECON、SCAND 和 SACSoN 上的离线评估中，相较于 NoMaD+NWM-XL，LiteNWM 将宏平均轨迹误差降低了 17.56%，并在 RTX 5090 上实现了 128.00 倍的端到端加速。同一个评估器无需针对提议器重新训练，即可从 NoMaD 迁移到 MBRA，使 MBRA 的宏平均轨迹误差降低 16.2%。在未见过的室内和室外环境中进行的真实机器人实验表明，相较于 NoMaD，LiteNWM 将导航成功率从 43.3% 提升至 83.3%。这些结果表明，LiteNWM 能够部署在实体机器人上，用于具备未来感知能力的规划和闭环导航。

papers.title: Memory Forcing: Attendable Mid-Horizon History for Streaming Video Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion enables causal video streaming without a bidirectional pass over the full clip, but existing few-step systems usually retain only the opening and most recent frames in a fixed-size KV cache. Once an event leaves this window, later frames can no longer attend to it, a failure we term mid-horizon forgetting. We present Memory Forcing, a few-step streaming method that preserves this missing history without increasing the cache size. Its Archive \& Working Banks partition the cache into sink, archive, and working regions, retaining diverse intermediate events alongside recent motion under fixed memory. Because absolute temporal indices drift outside the training range, Bank-aware RoPE reassigns indices at attention time so each bank remains distinguishable. At 1.3B, Memory Forcing leads on longer clips, shows the smallest drop from 5s to 60s among methods reporting all four lengths, and preserves subjects and scenes through leave-and-return. The same design scales to Wan2.2 5B, producing more physically plausible, realistic, and dynamic videos and, to our knowledge, the first public 5B model on this forcing line.
papers.summary_cn: Autoregressive video diffusion enables causal video streaming without a bidirectional pass over the full clip, but existing few-step systems usually retain only the opening and most recent frames in a fixed-size KV cache.
papers.contribution_cn: We present Memory Forcing, a few-step streaming method that preserves this missing history without increasing the cache size.
papers.relevance_cn: 匹配研究线：streaming video, efficient generation；关键词：autoregressive, causal video, streaming, few-step, cache, kv cache
papers.limitations_cn: 规则模式无法可靠判断实验质量与论文局限。

papers.title: Towards Safe World Models: Risks, Defenses, and Evaluation
papers.abstract: World models support planning, control, learning from imagined experience, and model-mediated evaluation by predicting action-conditioned consequences. Their safety cannot be inferred from predictive accuracy alone: errors in observations, state and memory, dynamics, evaluation, execution, or feedback can propagate into unsafe decisions and persist through updates. This work organizes the literature on world-model safety around a six-stage lifecycle covering data and observations, state and memory, dynamics and imagination, evaluation and planning, action and control, and feedback and update. We synthesize non-adversarial failures, attacks, defenses, evaluation protocols, benchmarks, and deployment conditions, and distinguish evidence directness from outcome level. The current evidence corpus contains 163 cited works. We use the framework to identify where claims are supported, where attribution remains unresolved, and which measurements are needed to connect model-level behavior to closed-loop and operational safety.
papers.summary_cn: World models support planning, control, learning from imagined experience, and model-mediated evaluation by predicting action-conditioned consequences.
papers.contribution_cn: 请快速查看方法图和主要实验表确认具体贡献。
papers.relevance_cn: 匹配研究线：world model；关键词：world model, action-conditioned, closed-loop
papers.limitations_cn: 规则模式无法可靠判断实验质量与论文局限。

papers.title: WorldGuide: Goal-Directed Video World Model for Procedural Task Execution
papers.abstract: Video generators and video-based world models can synthesize plausible visual trajectories, but long-horizon procedural tasks require generation to adapt to what has actually been produced. A model must determine the next action from its generated state, execute that action, and recognize when the task is complete. Open-loop generation cannot adapt to execution outcomes, while existing closed-loop systems often rely on pretrained executors or indirect verification. This leaves a gap between deciding an action and successfully realizing it. We formulate procedural video generation as \emph{closed-loop task execution in visual world space} and introduce \textbf{WorldGuide}. Given only an initial image and a task goal, WorldGuide predicts an atomic action, generates its corresponding video clip, and uses the generated result to select the next action or terminate. The Planner and Executor are trained on the same step-level procedural demonstrations: the Planner learns to predict the next atomic action or task completion from visual progress, while the Executor is directly trained to realize the predicted actions. Hierarchical visual memory maintains state across long-horizon execution with bounded history token cost. Due to the lack of step-level action-video supervision for joint planner-executor training, we introduce \textbf{WorldGuide Bench}: approximately 59K step-annotated videos across 245 tasks and 27 procedural categories. WorldGuide achieves a 33.33\% Task Success on \textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}, compared with 29.90\% for the strong recent video model MiniMax-H3, even though MiniMax-H3 receives reference action plans, and achieves 47.69\% on \textbf{VideoCraft-Bench} compared with 32.73\% for MiniMax-H3 under goal-only conditioning. These results demonstrate the importance of coupling planning with learned execution for goal-directed procedural video generation.
papers.summary_cn: Video generators and video-based world models can synthesize plausible visual trajectories, but long-horizon procedural tasks require generation to adapt to what has actually been produced.
papers.contribution_cn: Due to the lack of step-level action-video supervision for joint planner-executor training, we introduce \textbf{WorldGuide Bench}: approximately 59K step-annotated videos across 245 tasks and 27 procedural categories.
papers.relevance_cn: 匹配研究线：world model, video generation；关键词：world model, video world model, closed-loop, video generation
papers.limitations_cn: 规则模式无法可靠判断实验质量与论文局限。

papers.title: Beyond Successful Robot Demonstrations: Learning from Human Interactions and Modeling Failure Dynamics
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models offer a promising foundation for generalist robotic intelligence by predicting the consequences of actions. However, existing robotic datasets provide limited coverage of the diverse interaction dynamics required for generalizable world modeling. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer complementary interaction experience, yet the embodiment gap between human hands and robotic manipulators hinders effective cross-embodiment learning. Meanwhile, the predominance of successful demonstrations leaves failure dynamics substantially underrepresented, limiting the ability of world models to anticipate unsuccessful executions. To address these limitations, we introduce HF-WM, an action-conditioned world model that combines Human interaction learning with Failure-aware post-training. To bridge the embodiment gap, we develop a dual-branch framework that couples video generation with auxiliary pointflow prediction, using stabilized pointflow as a unified motion representation across human and robot interactions while suppressing egocentric camera motion. To improve failure modeling, we further perform Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training on perturbed actions derived from successful demonstrations, guided by action alignment and physical plausibility rewards, enabling the model to learn plausible failure dynamics without paired ground-truth videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HF-WM achieves state-of-the-art performance in action-conditioned video generation and exhibits strong utility for policy evaluation in downstream robotic tasks.
papers.summary_cn: Action-conditioned world models offer a promising foundation for generalist robotic intelligence by predicting the consequences of actions.

papers.title: LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs
papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn compact latent world models without pixel reconstruction. Existing JEPA pipelines typically train visual representations and action-conditioned dynamics before adding a control policy or solver. We introduce LeWAM, an end-to-end JEPA for control with: (1) a joint training objective over next latent state prediction and action flow matching, and (2) an isotropic Gaussian constraint on the latent state, enabling a single model to support direct policy execution and efficient planning by evaluating sampled actions with its learned latent dynamics. Compared with prior JEPAs in visual planning, LeWAM improves success rate from 28.6% to 89.7% on contact-rich tasks and from 10.9% to 46.2% on long-horizon tasks, and plans 32.3 times faster. On behavior cloning tasks in simulation and physical robots, LeWAM is also competitive with established methods. Interpretability analyses show that LeWAM learns control-relevant representations and action distributions effectively guiding test-time planning and control.

papers.title: Golden Anchor for Video Generation
papers.abstract: Video generation supports digital content creation, with applications in virtual avatars, AI-driven filmmaking, interactive game engines, and world models. State-of-the-art systems achieve controllability primarily through image-to-video (I2V) generation, in which an injected anchor image determines the identity, composition, and style of the resulting video. In modern pipelines, this anchor is synthesized by a text-to-image (T2I) generator. This raises a largely overlooked question: Are images obtained directly from the T2I model truly suitable for current video models? Our analysis shows that anchor aesthetic and quality scores are weakly correlated with downstream video quality. The structure-and-texture score is negatively correlated with I2V video quality in both the visual and motion dimensions. Fine-tuning the T2I model on an image reward accordingly yields anchors with visibly denser structural and character detail: they score higher on image metrics, yet lower the video reward on every I2V model we test and change downstream motion unpredictably. We therefore introduce Golden Anchor Learning (GAL), to our knowledge the first framework for learning golden anchors by optimizing a T2I generator with downstream video feedback. GAL evaluates candidate anchors through the videos they induce under a frozen I2V model and converts video rewards into image-level preferences for DPO fine-tuning of the T2I generator. On all four I2V models, GAL raises the VBench average by $2.97\%$--$8.46\%$ over the untuned generator. The rendered clips also score higher under VideoReward-Overall, and their extracted frames under HPSv3 and UniPercept. GAL yields consistent motion gains across all four I2V models, as measured by a $5.62\%$--$38.24\%$ increase in VBench dynamic degree. Although GAL is trained only on HunyuanVideo-1.5 renders, these gains extend to the other three I2V models.

papers.title: Unified Generative Video Compression with Autoregressive and Bidirectional Video Diffusion
papers.abstract: Video diffusion models can reconstruct visually compelling content from severely compressed representations at ultra-low bitrates, but they impose a rigid deployment trade-off. Bidirectional (BI) models achieve high quality through dense full-sequence attention, yet require the entire sequence before reconstruction and incur substantial latency. Autoregressive (AR) models enable low-delay streaming, but their restricted temporal context reduces compression efficiency. This tension is particularly relevant when a video stream must be decoded in real time yet is also stored for later, quality-oriented playback, making AR and BI models natural choices for the live and replay stages, respectively. To support both stages, we present UniGVC, a Unified Generative Video Codec that supports two decoding modes from a single bitstream. UniGVC-BI employs a BI-DiT with dense attention for quality-oriented random-access decoding, whereas UniGVC-AR uses windowed AR-DiT for low-delay streaming. Both paths share a hierarchical latent codec that recurrently produces the same conditions with ultra-low bitrates, allowing UniGVC-BI to serve as a conditional teacher for single-step distillation of UniGVC-AR. A tiny conditional video decoder further reduces streaming latency while preserving most of the reconstruction quality. On standard 1080p benchmarks, UniGVC-BI achieves the best overall rate-distortion-perception trade-off among the evaluated methods and produces temporally stable video at rates as low as 0.0005 bits per pixel. Meanwhile, UniGVC-AR remains competitive while decoding 1080p video at 36.85 FPS, over $250\times$ faster than UniGVC-BI. Code and models will be released later.
